params.body:
A middleware that sends the protective headers this site was missing, on every web response:

- `permissions-policy: camera=(), microphone=()`

Only the safe set: no Content-Security-Policy, which is a per-site decision. HSTS starts at one week; raise it once it has held.
A header the app already sends is left as it is.

## Evidence

- the tests were green before the change, and again after
- the exposure measurement judges this proposal once it is live: the headers have to be what the site answers with

Proposed by Elixir. A human merges.
params.title: Security: send 1 protective header(s)
